calculation.description: Multiply trailing 20-day return by 10-day directional efficiency (signed return divided by absolute-return sum), then remove contemporaneous cross-sectional linear exposure to 5-day return. Positive values favor efficient trends not explained by short-term return exposure. Inputs are lagged and observable at decision time.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC was positive in 2020-2022 (0.040557), 2023-2024 (0.029594), and 2025-2027 (0.028193). The 15-asset cross-section warrants conservative uncertainty interpretation.

provenance: Daily paper IC and ICIR gates evaluated on all available tradable benchmark instruments; DXY/VIX and other macro-only series were not traded. Max correlation is an audit hint, not a substitute for deterministic library recomputation.
